dimensions.name: Rubric accuracy
dimensions.definition: Agreement between model and reviewer points for each rubric criterion.
dimensions.measurement: Share of (case, criterion) pairs where model earned == expected earned

dimensions.name: Evidence quality
dimensions.definition: Model evidenceRefs point to spans of the student answer that support the awarded points.
dimensions.measurement: Reviewer-rated share of awarded criteria with a valid supporting span

dimensions.name: False acceptance rate
dimensions.definition: Cases expected insufficient_evidence that the model marked accepted.

dimensions.name: False insufficient rate
dimensions.definition: Cases expected accepted that the model marked insufficient_evidence.

dimensions.name: Hint-dependency tracking
dimensions.definition: Hint-assisted work is never recorded as independent evidence.
dimensions.measurement: Share of assisted cases whose skill evidence uses correct_with_hint (any correct_independent is a failure)

dimensions.name: Feedback usefulness
dimensions.definition: Feedback addresses the expected feedbackFocus points without giving away full solutions.
dimensions.measurement: Reviewer rating per case on a 1–4 scale

dimensions.name: Prerequisite precision
dimensions.definition: Counterexample cases produce no forbidden prerequisite events.
dimensions.measurement: Share of prerequisite cases with no forbidden events emitted
